value.syntax: # [doc = " A floating-point value in the canonical form §4.2 fixes for it —"] # [doc = " restrained."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The width and bit pattern of the shortest form are what is stored, so"] # [doc = " two floats are equal exactly when their names are equal, the canonical"] # [doc = " reduction happens once at construction, and the derived order is"] # [doc = " already the bytewise order of names."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{Float, FloatWidth};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let f = Float::from_f64(1.5).expect(\"canonical\");"] # [doc = " assert_eq!(f.width(), FloatWidth::Half);"] # [doc = " assert_eq!(f.to_f64(), 1.5);"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Copy , Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq , Hash , PartialOrd , Ord)] pub struct Float { width : FloatWidth , bits : u64 , }
